custom_field: প্রতি প্রশ্নের মান ১ ও ভুল উত্তরের জন্য ০.৫০ কাটা যাবে।

English-Wizard.question: ১) They saw the rabbit run away. (Make it passive)
English-Wizard.option1: The rabbit was seen run away by them.
English-Wizard.option2: The rabbit was seen ran away by them.
English-Wizard.option3: The rabbit was been seen run away by them.
English-Wizard.option4: The rabbit was seen to run away by them.
English-Wizard.exp:
• Active voice থেকে passive voice করার নিয়ম:
- Active voice এর object টি passive voice এর subject হয়।
-Tense অনুযায়ী auxiliary verb বসে।
- তারপর মূল verb এর past participle হয়।
- Active voice এর subject টি passive voice এর object হয়।
- তার পূর্বে preposition (by, at, to, in) বসে।

• Past Indefinite Tense এর active voice কে passive voice এ রূপান্তর করার সময় was/were + verb এর Past Participle বসে। 
• Need, see, bid, dare, make, hear, feel, let, know, behold, watch প্রভৃতি verb গুলোর পর Active Voice-এ to উহ্য থাকে।
- তবে passive করার সময় তাদের পরে to বসে।

- নিয়মানুযায়ী সঠিক উত্তর
Active: They saw the rabbit run away.
Passive: The rabbit was seen to run away by them.

English-Wizard.question: ২) He pleases us. (Make it passive)
English-Wizard.option1: We will be pleased by him.
English-Wizard.option2: We are pleased by him.
English-Wizard.option3: We were pleased with him.
English-Wizard.option4: We are pleased with him.
English-Wizard.exp:
- Active voice: He pleases us.
- Passive voice: We are pleased with him.

• Active voice কে Passive voice এ রূপান্তরের নিয়ম:
- Active Voice এর object‌ টি Passive voice এর subject হয় + Tense অনুযায়ী Auxiliary verb + মূল verb এর past participle + Active voice এর subject টি Passive voice এর object হয় এবং তার পূর্বে Preposition (By, with, at, to, in) বসে।

• ব্যক্তির ক্ষেত্রে with বসে আর ব্যক্তির কাজ বা বস্তুর উপরে সন্তুষ্টি বোঝাতে at বসে।
- যেহেতু প্রশ্নে ব্যক্তির উপর সন্তুষ্টি বোঝানো হয়েছে তাই pleased with বসবে।

English-Wizard.question: ৩) Nobody trusts a traitor. (Make it passive)
English-Wizard.option1: A traitor should not be trusted.
English-Wizard.option2: A traitor is trusted.
English-Wizard.option3: A traitor is not trusted by anybody.
English-Wizard.option4: Everybody hates a traitor.
English-Wizard.exp:
- Active Voice: Nobody trusts a traitor.
- Passive Voice: A traitor is not trusted by anybody.

• Active থেকে Passive করতে হলে,
- Active Voice এর Subject – Passive Voice- এ Object হয়।
- Active Voice এর Object – Passive Voice এ- Subject হয়।
- অতিরিক্ত be verb বসে এবং মূল Verb এর Past Participle বসে।
- Object এর আগে by বসে।

• এই হিসেবে "Nobody trusts a traitor." এর Passive Voice
- A traitor is not trusted by anybody.
-  Nobody = not anybody.
- আবার, No one/None = not anyone.

More Example:
Active Voice: No one believes a deceiver.
Passive Voice: A deceiver is not believed by anyone.

English-Wizard.question: ৪) He killed himself. (Make it passive)
English-Wizard.option1: He was killed by himself.
English-Wizard.option2: He was killed himself.
English-Wizard.option3: He himself was killed by him.
English-Wizard.option4: Himself was killed by him.
English-Wizard.exp:
• Reflexive object যুক্ত  Active voice কে Passive voice এ রূপান্তর করার নিয়ম:
• Reflexive object গুলো হচ্ছে - himself, myself, themself, ourself etc.

• Structure:
- প্রদত্ত Active voice এর Subject টি অপরিবর্তিত অবস্থায় Passive voice এর Subject হিসাবে প্রথমে বসে + tense ও person অনুযায়ী auxiliary verb বসে + মূল verb এর past participle form বসে + by বসে +  Reflexive object টি বসে।

• Active: He killed himself.
• Passive: He was killed by himself.

English-Wizard.question: ৫) What is the verb form of 'Cross'?
English-Wizard.option1: Crussify
English-Wizard.option2: Encross
English-Wizard.option3: Crucify
English-Wizard.option4: Crossen
English-Wizard.exp:
• Cross
- ক্রসচিহ্ন,
-  ক্রুশবিদ্ধ করার জন্য আড়াআড়িভাবে স্থাপিত কাঠের টুকরা, ক্রুশ।

- এর verb from - Crucify (ক্রুশবিদ্ধ করে মারা।)

Source: Accessible Dictionary.

English-Wizard.question: ৬) Don't waste your efforts. (Make it passive)
English-Wizard.option1: Let your efforts not to waste.
English-Wizard.option2: Let your efforts to be not wasted.
English-Wizard.option3: Let your efforts not to be waste.
English-Wizard.option4: Let not your efforts be wasted.
English-Wizard.exp:
Active Voice: Don't waste your efforts.
Passive Voice: Let not your efforts be wasted.

• Voice এর ক্ষেত্রে শুধু মূল verb দিয়ে শুরু হওয়া Imperative sentence এর Active voice থেকে passive এ রূপান্তরিত করার সময় -
- প্রথমে Let not  বসবে।
- Active voice এর object টির subject রূপে বসবে।
- be বসবে।
- মূল verb এর past participle বসবে।

- Structure: Let not + object টির subject হয় + be + মূল verb এর past participle.

English-Wizard.question: ৭) I am to make a call. (Make it passive)
English-Wizard.option1: A call was to be made by me.
English-Wizard.option2: A call is to be made by me.
English-Wizard.option3: A call has to be made by me.
English-Wizard.option4: A call had to be made by me.
English-Wizard.exp:
• Active voice থেকে passive voice করার নিয়ম:
- Active voice এর object টি passive voice এর subject হয়।
- Tense অনুযায়ী auxiliary verb বসে।
- তারপর মূল verb এর past participle হয়।
- Active voice এর subject টি passive voice এর object হয়।
- তার পূর্বে preposition (by, with, at, to, in) বসে।

- Active voice: I am to make a call.
- Passive voice: A call is to be made by me.

English-Wizard.question: ৮) The basket contains freshly picked grapes. (Make it passive)
English-Wizard.option1: Freshly picked grapes are contained with the basket.
English-Wizard.option2: Freshly picked grapes are contained by the basket.
English-Wizard.option3: Freshly picked grapes are contained to the basket.
English-Wizard.option4: Freshly picked grapes are contained in the basket.
English-Wizard.exp:
• Active: The basket contains freshly picked grapes.
- Passive: Freshly picked grapes are contained in the basket.

• কিছ কিছু Active voice কে Passive voice এ রুপান্তর করার ক্ষেত্রে এদের পূর্বে 'by' বসেনা।
- এ জাতীয় কিছু verb হচ্ছে - annoyed with, marvelled at, surprised at, seized with, contained in etc..

• The basket contains freshly picked grapes.
- উল্লিখত বাক্যের object -freshly picked grapes বসেছে passive voice এ subject হিসেবে।
- যেহেতু বাক্যটি present indefinite tense এ গঠিত তাই মূল verb হিসেবে are বসেছে ।
- তারপর verb এর past participle form.
- এরপর in + Subject এর objective form.

• এ জাতীয় আরোও একটি উদাহরণ হচ্ছে -
- Active: Panic seized the writer.
- Passive: The writer was seized with panic.

• Active: The parcel contained important materials.
- Passive: Important materials were contained in the parcel.

Source: Advanced Learners Communicative English Grammar & Composition By Chowdhury & Hossain.

English-Wizard.question: ৯) It is impossible to do this. (Make it passive)
English-Wizard.option1: This is must be done.
English-Wizard.option2: This can't be done.
English-Wizard.option3: Doing this is impossible.
English-Wizard.option4: This is impossible to be done.
English-Wizard.exp:
• Active: It is impossible to do this.
• Passive: This can't be done.

• এই কাঠামো যুক্ত passive voice-এর ক্ষেত্রে সাধারণ নিয়ম ব্যবহার করা হয় না। 
- এগুলো একটু ব্যতিক্রম নিয়মে passive voice করতে হয়।

• এটা ভাবার্থের বিচারে Passive Voice করতে হবে। 
- This is impossible to be done. সঠিক মনে হলেও সঠিক নয়। 
- কারণ নিয়মানুযায়ী Adjective (Impossible) এর পর Passive Form এ কখনো infinitive to বসে না।
- তাই This is impossible to be done - উত্তর হবে না।

English-Wizard.question: ১০) Never ignore the truth. (Make it passive)
English-Wizard.option1: Don't ignore the truth.
English-Wizard.option2: Let be never ignore the truth.
English-Wizard.option3: Let the truth be ignored.
English-Wizard.option4: Let never the truth be ignored.
English-Wizard.exp:
• Never যুক্ত Imperative Sentence কে Passive করার structure: 
- প্রথমে Let Never বসে
- Object টি Subject রূপে বসে
- be বসে 
- মূল verb এর  Past participle হয়।

তাই নিয়মানুযায়ী,
Active: Never tell a lie.
Passive: Let never a lie be told. 

Active: Never ignore the truth.
Passive: Let never the truth be ignored.

English-Wizard.question: ১১) When was Ashraf born? (Make it active)
English-Wizard.option1: When was Ashraf being born to his mother?
English-Wizard.option2: When was Ashraf's mother born him?
English-Wizard.option3: When did Ashraf's mother born him?
English-Wizard.option4: When did Ashraf's mother bear him?
English-Wizard.exp:
Passive: When was Ashraf born?
Active: When did Ashraf's mother bear him?

• Passive Voice এ যদি by + Object না থাকে এবং verb টি যদি পেশা বা নির্দিষ্ট ব্যক্তি বা বস্তুর সাথে Related কাজ হয় তাহলে active voice এ পরিণত করার সময় ঐ পেশাজীবী বা ঐ নির্দিষ্ট ব্যক্তি বা বস্তুর নাম Subject হিসেবে বসাতে হবে।

• When was Ashraf born?
- এই বাক্যে - by + Object নেই, তাই নিয়মানুসারে একটি subject আনতে হবে।
- যেহেতু মা সন্তান জন্মদান করে থাকেন, তাই subject হিসেবে Ashraf's mother আসবে।

- সঠিক উত্তর হবে - When did Ashraf's mother bear him?
- Past Indefinite Tense এ প্রশ্নবোধক বাক্যে Active Voice এ did- Subject এর আগে বসাতে হয়।
- আর When Adverb হওয়ায় Passive করার ক্ষেত্রে এর কোন Function নেই।

• Bear হচ্ছে born এর present form.
• Conjugation: Bear - Bore - Born.

English-Wizard.question: ১২) Who will have cleaned the room? (Make it passive)
English-Wizard.option1: By whom will the room have cleaned?
English-Wizard.option2: By whom will the room have been cleaned?
English-Wizard.option3: By whom will the room been cleaned?
English-Wizard.option4: By whom the room will be cleaned?
English-Wizard.exp:
• Who যুক্ত Interrogative Sentence এর Active Voice কে Passive Voice এ পরিণত করার নিয়ম:
- Who এর পরিবর্তে প্রথমে By whom বসে।
- Tense ও Person অনুযায়ী Auxiliary Verb বসাতে হয়। 
- Object টি Subject হয়।
- Tense অনুযায়ী কর্তার পরে  be/being/been বসাতে হয়। 
- মূল Verb এর Past Participle বসে।
- সবার শেষে প্রশ্নবোধক চিহ্ন বসে। 

• Active voice টি Future perfect tense এ আছে।
- Future Perfect Tense যুক্ত active voice কে passive voice করার জন্য structure:
- Sub + shall/will + have + been + V3.

• সুতরাং, নিয়মানুযায়ী, 
Active: Who will have cleaned the room?
Passive: By whom will the room have been cleaned?

More Example:
Active: Who will help you?
Passive: By whom will you be helped?

Active: Who is helping her?
Passive: By whom is she being helped?

Active: Who has broken the glasses?
Passive: By whom have the glasses been broken?

English-Wizard.question: ১৩) Habib was called a hero for his brave behaviour. (Make it active)
English-Wizard.option1: People called Habib a hero for his brave behaviour.
English-Wizard.option2: It was hero Habib was called for his brave behaviour.
English-Wizard.option3: Hero for his brave behaviour was called to Habib.
English-Wizard.option4: People did call Habib a hero for being his brave behaviour.
English-Wizard.exp:
• আমজনতার সাথে Related কাজ হলে Subject হিসেবে People বসাতে হবে।
- প্রথমে People বসাতে হবে।
- মূল Verb এর ঠিক আগের 'be' Verb 'was' বাদ যাবে।
- মূল Verb এর ঠিক আগের 'be' Verb এর গঠন অনুযায়ী মূল Verb বসবে।
-  Subject টি Object হবে।
- বাকি অংশ বসবে।

- Passive Voice: Habib was called a hero for his brave behaviour.
- Active Voice: People called Habib a hero for his brave behaviour.

English-Wizard.question: ১৪) They are cleaning the zone. (Make it passive)
English-Wizard.option1: The zone has been cleaned by them.
English-Wizard.option2: The zone will be cleaned by them.
English-Wizard.option3: The zone is being cleaned by them.
English-Wizard.option4: The zone was being cleaned by them.
English-Wizard.exp:
• Active Voice: They are cleaning the zone.
• Passive Voice: The zone is being cleaned by them.

• Present Continuous Tense এর  Active voice থেকে Passive voice এ রূপান্তরের নিয়ম:
- Subject +
- (is /am / are) +
- being +
- Verb in past participle +
- Others.

English-Wizard.question: ১৫) In the word 'Omniscient', the prefix 'omni' refers to -
English-Wizard.option1: Bright
English-Wizard.option2: All
English-Wizard.option3: Small
English-Wizard.option4: Odd
English-Wizard.exp:
• Omniscient (noun)
English Meaning: One who knows everything.
Bangla Meaning: সর্বজ্ঞ/ সর্বদর্শী।
- তাই এইখানে omni-  এর অর্থ হচ্ছে- সর্বত্র বা, All. 

• অন্য অপশনগুলোর অর্থ -
- Bright - উজ্জ্বল।
- Small - ছোট, ক্ষুদ্র।
- Odd - অস্বাভাবিক, অদ্ভুত।

Source: Accessible Dictionary by Bangla Academy.

English-Wizard.question: ১৬) Do you know them? (Make it passive)
English-Wizard.option1: They be known by you?
English-Wizard.option2: Are they known to you?
English-Wizard.option3: Are they known with you?
English-Wizard.option4: Do you know to them?
English-Wizard.exp:
Active voice: Do you know them?
Passive form:  Are they known to you?

• Active voice কে Passive voice- এ রূপান্তরের নিয়ম:
- Active Voice এর object‌ টি Passive voice এর subject হয়,
- Tense অনুযায়ী Auxiliary verb,
- মূল verb এর past participle,
- Active voice এর subject টি Passive voice এর object হয় এবং তার পূর্বে Preposition (By, with, at, to ,in) বসে।
- আর known এর পর preposition to ব্যবহৃত হয়।

English-Wizard.question: ১৭) Which prefix or suffix will be added to the word 'Devil'?
English-Wizard.option1: En - suffix
English-Wizard.option2: Be - prefix
English-Wizard.option3: En - prefix
English-Wizard.option4: None of the above
English-Wizard.exp:
- Devil (Noun)
অশুভ আত্মা; প্রেত; নিষ্ঠুর বা ষড়যন্ত্রকারী ব্যক্তি।

- Bedevil (verb transitive) 
- গোলমেলে করা হয়েছে; ভণ্ডুল করা হয়েছে; জটিল করা হয়েছে এমন।

Source: Accessible Dictionary.

English-Wizard.question: ১৮) Apprehension seized the man. (Make it passive)
English-Wizard.option1: The man was seized with apprehension.
English-Wizard.option2: The man was seize with apprehension.
English-Wizard.option3: The man is seized with apprehension.
English-Wizard.option4: The man is seized by apprehension.
English-Wizard.exp:
- Active: Apprehension seized the man.
- Passive: The man was seized with apprehension.

 - Active voice থেকে passive voice করার নিয়ম:

• Active voice এর object টি passive voice এর subject হয়।
- Tense অনুযায়ী auxiliary verb বসে।
- তারপর মূল verb এর past participle হয়।
- Active voice এর subject টি passive voice এর object হয়।
- তার পূর্বে preposition (by, with, at, to, in) বসে।

• Passive Voice – Seized এর পর by না বসে with বসে।

English-Wizard.question: ১৯) Jhuma decided to sell the house. (Make it passive)
English-Wizard.option1: Jhuma decided that the house should been sold.
English-Wizard.option2: Jhuma decides that the house should be sold.
English-Wizard.option3: Jhuma decided that the house is being sold.
English-Wizard.option4: Jhuma decided that the house should be sold.
English-Wizard.exp:
• Agree/ be anxious/ arrange/ determine/ be determined/ decide/ demand + infinitive + object যুক্ত Active voice কে passive করার নিয়ম:

- প্রদত্ত Active voice এর subject ও verb বসবে।
- that বসবে।
- infinitive এর পরের Object (direct object) বসবে।
- should be বসবে।
- infinitive এর পরের verb এর past participle বসবে।

Active: Jhuma decided to sell the house.
Passive: Jhuma decided that the house should be sold.

Source: Advanced Learner's by Chowdhury & Hossain.

English-Wizard.question: ২০) One should tell the truth. (Make it passive)
English-Wizard.option1: The truth should be told.
English-Wizard.option2: The truth shall be told.
English-Wizard.option3: The truth is being told.
English-Wizard.option4: Everybody should be telling the truth.
English-Wizard.exp:
• One + should যুক্ত Sentence কে passive করার নিয়ম:
1. প্রথমে object টি Subject রূপে বসে,
2. should be + মূল Verb এর Past Participle বসে।

Active Voice: One should take care of one's health.
Passive Voice: Health should be taken care of.

Active: One should tell the truth.
Passive: The truth should be told.

Source: Advanced Learner's English Grammar & Composition by Chowdhury & Hossain.
